info.title: Casa Pepe simulation API
info.description: Local, in-memory simulated AWS incident environment. No real agent or AWS actions. API.md is the companion integration guide.

get.summary: Check API process health, independently of simulated AWS
Read complete snapshot; never advances time or draws randomness
